name: The Devil
overview: Scripture reveals the devil as the father of lies and a murderer from the beginning, actively opposing the truth and seeking to steal, kill, and destroy (John 8:44; John 10:10). Believers are called to resist his schemes by putting on the whole armor of God and submitting to God, which causes the devil to flee (Ephesians 6:11; James 4:7). Though even demons believe in God and tremble, they remain enemies to the faithful, who are assured that through Christ, Satan will ultimately be crushed underfoot (James 2:19; Romans 16:20). This study also considers practical warnings about idle hands being the devil’s playground, the influence of music, and the dangers of worshipping the devil.
